about_the_game:
Descend into the Unknown.

You and your friends must navigate the depths of a procedurally generated labyrinth. Starting in a perpetually descending elevator, you'll emerge onto a new level with each terrifying stop, facing a fresh wave of horrors and a growing debt to repay.

Key Features:

  • Co-op Descent: Work together to survive the ever-deepening levels. Coordinate deliveries, share resources, and fight off monstrous entities lurking in the shadows.

  • Debt Management: Balance your dwindling funds to pay off the ever-increasing debt at each level. Failure to pay means facing the wrath of your unseen captors.

  • Intensifying Horror: Experience a chilling atmosphere of existential dread with escalating scares and terrifying encounters.

  • Procedural Generation: Explore a unique and unpredictable facility with each playthrough, featuring new level layouts, monsters, and challenges.

  • Shop for Survival: Spend your hard-earned cash on vital supplies, powerful weapons, and strange items to aid in your descent.

  • Complete Sinister Tasks: Fulfill the bizarre demands of your unseen overlords, from delivering cryptic packages to containing dangerous threats.

Will you and your friends completely pay off your debt and earn your freedom, or will the horrors within this terrifying abyss consume you?

content_descriptors.notes: Player characters can die through various means. Player characters can use fictional medical drugs recklessly.
